connector.name: Multi Gmail MCP
connector.registryDescription: Manage multiple Gmail accounts in Claude Desktop - search, send, reply, draft, and organize.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package multi-gmail-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the gx-55 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
